author: NASA
description:
As people around Earth come together to participate in the FIFA World Cup, NASA astronauts Jessica Meir, Chris Williams, Jack Hathaway, and European Space Agency (ESA) astronaut Sophie Adenot join in the celebration from aboard the International Space Station and send their well-wishes to the ground.

Learn more about the station: https://nasa.gov/station
Here's how we're bringing NASA science to the World Cup: https://go.nasa.gov/4okdkyW

Credit: NASA
title: Astronauts on the Space Station Celebrate the 2026 FIFA World Cup

author: NASA
description:
World Cup fever just hit low Earth orbit!

Watch astronauts Jessica Meir, Sophie Adenot, Jack Hathaway and Christopher Williams take the beautiful game to the International Space Station in an epic microgravity match with the adidas FIFA World Cup Trionda Pro ball.

In addition to having fun with the Trionda, they also conducted experiments to analyze the ball's internal mass, which improves our understanding of how internal mass, including embedded sensors, can influence stability and rotation in real-world playing conditions. Just one more way space station science makes life better for people on Earth!

Credit: NASA

title: The Ultimate Away Game: World Cup Fever on the ISS 🌌🏆
